pub assume_specification<T>[ Arc::<[T]>::new_uninit_slice ](
    len: usize,
) -> (res: Arc<[MaybeUninit<T>]>)
    ensures
        (&*res)@.len() == len,
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < (&*res)@.len() ==> (&*res)@[i].mem_contents().is_uninit(),
;
